prompt: Document in README development instructions that search_text tests require ripgrep on PATH. Keep the note concise and avoid unrelated changes.
Add a read-only fs_exists tool that reports whether a project-scoped path exists. Apply existing path policy, wire schema and dispatch, document it, and test missing and out-of-scope paths.
acceptance: Schema, dispatch, handler and README agree
Out-of-scope paths fail under existing policy
Isolated success/error regressions and required Rust checks pass

prompt: Audit managed-process cancellation and future-drop cleanup. Add a regression for any uncovered descendant cleanup path, and fix a demonstrated defect if one is found.
acceptance: Evidence identifies covered and uncovered cleanup paths
Any claimed fix has reproduction and regression evidence

prompt: Review whether an edit followed by an external file modification can be safely undone. Add a missing behavior regression or fix a reproduced defect while preserving the conflicting file.
acceptance: Undo state and provenance are consistent
Success and conflict evidence use temporary files

prompt: Verify that a failed provider request followed by context pressure preserves unseen tool results exactly. Extend regression coverage for a concrete gap and fix it if reproduced.
acceptance: Failed requests do not mark results seen
No unbounded retry or destructive compaction

prompt: Compare TUI slash-command help against dispatch and README. Correct a demonstrated mismatch with a focused test, and provide manual verification evidence for any visible change.
acceptance: Help, dispatch and README are consistent
Changes stay in the demonstrated mismatch
Visible changes have manual evidence or an explicit environment blocker

prompt: Investigate why an LLM cannot call search_history in this project. Report exact registration and dispatch evidence and possible remedies. Do not modify files.
acceptance: Identifies absent default schema and present internal dispatch
Does not claim the behavior was fixed

prompt: Fix a single-file bug, then use impact_analyze to recommend verification. Prefer a focused check when evidence supports it; otherwise run the broad project test command. Do not claim unexecuted tests passed.
acceptance: No unexecuted test claimed as passed

prompt: Change code spanning two modules with callers in a third module. Use impact_analyze to identify affected files and recommend verification for each affected language ecosystem.
acceptance: Each affected language has a recommendation

prompt: Refactor a widely-called function. Use impact_analyze with max_depth 2, inspect truncated/ambiguous warnings, and fall back to broad verification when the graph is incomplete.
acceptance: Truncation warning honored with broad verification

prompt: Change a symbol whose name occurs in multiple files. Use impact_analyze and treat name-only matches conservatively; recommend broad verification rather than claiming exact coverage.
acceptance: Ambiguous edges not presented as exact

prompt: Change code with no identifiable test candidates. Use impact_analyze and fall back to project-level verification with an explicit unknown-coverage reason.
Change a deleted file or a file with missing RepoMap coverage. Use impact_analyze, report impact as unknown, and run full verification without claiming focused coverage.
acceptance: Obligations not marked fulfilled from recommendation alone
